March 1st /9/6
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A code telegram has been received at the Arsenal from Peking saying that the Central Government has received information that 200 rebel sympathisers arrived recently in Shanghai from Dalny, and are staying in various lodging houses in this port.
A high military officer named Tsang Chi Hyuin 了長絲幽員力 arrived yesterday at the Arsenal from Peking. It is said that he has been sent here to watch General Yang, who is suspected of having entered into a secret conspiracy with General Fong Kuo Chang 馮國璋 of Nanking to start a rising in this province.
At 10 a.m. yesterday General Yang went to Woosung, where he had a consultation with General Lu about the new fort, referred to in yesterday's report. They also discussed the building of barracks for the troops at Yang Ching 洋涇 Pootung.
Four hundred extra workmen will start at the Arsenal to-day. The wages of first class mechanics employed in the Arsenal have been increased from $5.00 to $6.00.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmmmmmm
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

F: O: REG
编号....................................
日期...................................
1926年3月1日
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

兵工厂收到来自北京的一封密码电报，称中央政府获悉，200名叛乱同情者最近从达里尼（Dalny，音译）抵达上海，正寓居本港各旅馆内。

一名名为 Tsang Chi Hyuin 了長絲幽員力 的高级军官昨日从北京抵达兵工厂。据悉，他奉命来此监视杨将军，因怀疑杨将军与南京的冯国璋将军秘密勾结，企图在本省发动起义。

昨日上午10时，杨将军前往吴淞，就昨日报告中提及的新炮台事宜与卢将军进行磋商。他们还讨论了在浦东洋泾为部队修建营房的事宜。

今日将有四百名额外工人开始在兵工厂做工。兵工厂雇用的一等技工的工资已从5.00元增加至6.00元。

您顺从的仆人，
mmmmmmmmmmm
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

ALLEGED GERMAN CARGO-RUNNING.

The Yucatan, 3,585 tons, of the North
Pacific Steamship Company, according to
Japanese papers, is suspected of having
on board goods destined for Germany,
via American ports. The Asahi states
that the Superintendent of Customs at
Moji was requested by the British au-
thorities to institute a special search on
board the Yucatan, expected to enter
Moji yesterday (19th instant), and sus-
pected of carrying contraband of war.
The Customs Superintendent passed the
request on to the Kure Admiralty, and
as a result Commander Fukuyo and other
naval officers arrived at Moji on the 17th
instant to examine the suspected steamer,
whose Captain is stated to be a German
named Krien. The O aka paper adds
that the Yucatan left Moji for Shanghai
on the 8th instant, taking on board 550
tons of dynamite apples, and other goods.
On 19th inst, at 9.30 a.m. the Yucatan
arrived at Moji. The naval authorities
immediately proceeded on board and
made a close examination and search,
which was continued in the afternoon.
No information was available regarding
the result at the time of going to press.

THE QUESTION OF THE DAY.
HAVE YOU USED PEARS' SOAP? If
you have not, you have not done your duty
by your skin and complexion. If, on the
other hand you HAVE used PEARS,
you can feel happy. There can be no
doubt about that.
S'dney. 27th Nov 1904 242 S. W.

涉嫌向德国运送货物。

据日本报纸报道，北太平洋轮船公司（North Pacific Steamship Company）所属、吨位为3,585吨的“尤卡坦”号（Yucatan）轮，被怀疑船上载有经美国港口运往德国的货物。《朝日新闻》称，英国当局请求门司海关监督长对预计于昨日（本月19日）进入门司港、并被怀疑携带战争违禁品的“尤卡坦”号进行特别搜查。海关监督长将此请求转交吴镇守府，结果福代（Fukuyo，音译）指挥官及其他海军军官于本月17日抵达门司，检查该嫌疑轮船，据称其船长是一名名为克里恩（Krien，音译）的德国人。《大阪》报纸补充说，“尤卡坦”号于本月8日离开门司前往上海，装载了550吨炸药苹果（dynamite apples，原文如此）及其他货物。本月19日上午9时30分，“尤卡坦”号抵达门司。海军当局立即登船进行了仔细检查和搜查，搜查工作持续至下午。截至今日付印时，尚无关于检查结果的消息。

今日话题。
您使用过皮尔斯香皂（PEARS' SOAP）吗？如果您没有用过，那您就没有尽到呵护肌肤和容颜的责任。另一方面，如果您用过皮尔斯香皂，您可以感到欣慰。这一点毫无疑问。
悉尼。1904年11月27日 242 S. W.
